@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya
@graph.description: Private 3-day tour from Surabaya: Kawah Ijen, Mount Bromo sunrise, Madakaripura Waterfall. All-inclusive — transport, permits, guide, hotel.

@graph.name: Day 1: Surabaya to Bondowoso for Ijen Staging
@graph.description: The route begins with a transfer from Surabaya to the Bondowoso side so the Ijen segment can be handled properly. After hotel check-in, the required screening is completed before the climb window begins.

item.name: Surabaya to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Pickup by our team at your location in Surabaya. After meeting at the confirmed pick-up point, begin the overland transfer toward Bondowoso (Ijen area) as scheduled in the route plan.

item.name: Lunch at Local Restaurant
item.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch (cost not included). This is the planned meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

item.name: Local Restaurant to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Continue the overland journey from the restaurant toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

item.name: Check-in Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Arrive in Bondowoso and complete the hotel check-in process. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and the basic check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer.

item.name: Ijen health screening
item.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a scheduled screening session as listed in the itinerary to complete the required check before the Ijen-area program.

item.name: Dinner at Accommodation
item.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation or a nearby restaurant (included). This is the planned dinner time after the transfer and screening, scheduled as an included meal for the day.

@graph.name: Day 2: Ijen Climb and Transfer Toward the Bromo Side
@graph.description: After the Ijen sequence, the route moves west toward the Bromo side. This day is the operational bridge of the package and works best when guests understand it as a serious transfer day, not a light scenic drive.

item.name: Ijen Tour Experience
item.description: Follow the entire Ijen tour series. This block represents the full scheduled Ijen program as arranged for the day, completed in sequence before the onward transfer to the Bromo area later.

item.name: Return to Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Depart from the Ijen area after completing the hike and transfer back to the hotel in Bondowoso.

item.name: Ijen Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out from the Ijen area hotel. This is the formal check-out step after finishing the Ijen tour series, preparing for lunch and the transfer toward the Bromo area.

item.name: Lunch at Restaurant
item.description: Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (included). This is the planned meal break after hotel check-out, allowing time to sit down, eat, and reset before the overland drive to Bromo.

item.name: Journey to Bromo
item.description: Start the journey to the Bromo area (about 3-4 hours). This is the main overland transfer segment from the Ijen-area base (Bondowoso City) to the Bromo area accommodation zone.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-in
item.description: Arrive in Bromo area, check-in hotel. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and completing check-in so you can rest and prepare for the next day’s Bromo program.

@graph.name: Day 3: Bromo Sunrise, Madakaripura, and Return to Surabaya
@graph.description: The final day combines the Bromo sunrise sequence with the Madakaripura stop before the route returns to Surabaya. It is productive and high-contrast, but still depends on disciplined timing across the full day.

item.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Experience
item.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the scheduled Mount Bromo sunrise tour sequence by Jeep, completing the morning program within the allocated time block.

item.name: Hotel Breakfast
item.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return to the Bromo hotel after the morning Jeep tour and take a short breakfast break before the mid-day transition.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out, travel to Madakaripura. Complete hotel check-out and begin the transfer toward Madakaripura Waterfall to continue the day’s itinerary sequence.

item.name: Check-out and Transfer to Madakaripura
item.description: Depart from the Bromo hotel after check-out and continue the overland transfer to Madakaripura Waterfall.

item.name: Madakaripura Trekking
item.description: Arrive at Madakaripura and start trekking. This is the main on-site activity window at Madakaripura Waterfall, dedicated to the trek segment as listed in the schedule.

item.name: Lunch After Trek (Own Expense)
item.description: After trekking, have lunch (fees not included). This is the planned meal break after the Madakaripura trekking segment, with dining costs handled personally.

item.name: Transfer to Surabaya
item.description: Journey to Surabaya. Begin the return transfer from the Madakaripura area to Surabaya, closing the day tour route.

item.name: Arrival in Surabaya
item.description: Arrived in Surabaya. Complete arrival procedures and proceed to the final drop-off point as applicable.

@graph.reviewBody:
It was an absolutely amazing experience! We did the 3-day tour from Surabaya to Ijen, Bromo, and the Madakaripura waterfalls. Enchanting places that we were able to enjoy even more thanks to the excellent organization and the great care of our guide, Rendi, and our attentive driver.
The timing and organization were truly top-notch. Everything was organized perfectly.

I did the 3-Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya, and it was honestly one of the best experiences of my life!

A huge thank you to our amazing tour guide Kiki and our driver Holili. They made the whole trip so easy, stress-free, and truly unforgettable. They were professional, friendly, and always made sure everything ran smoothly.

Every single stop was incredible, and the views were beyond anything I can describe. From the blue fire at Ijen to the sunrise over Bromo and the stunning Madakaripura Waterfall, every moment was absolutely perfect.

I highly, highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting East Java. It was an experience I’ll never forget!
The tour guides were extremely friendly and accommodating. One of our friends was injured and they helped him as well. Overall, fantastic planning from the team!

What an unbelievable experience I don't think there is a better tour guide anywhere than Anjas the personal touch he provides and the knowledge he as over everywhere we went will put this company head and shoulders above the rest.

JVTO takes pride in assuring their customers by giving them prompt prior information and were quick to answer any questions we had. The driver Yandi and guide Boy, who were assigned to us, were great.
Rendi and Fredi were great tour hosts. All your needs were taken care of throughout the tour. All the days were fully explained in advance what to expect and when to be ready.

We recently completed a tour by Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) to Mt Bromo as well as IJEN and we were very satisfied with the arrangements made by the team. The team was very responsive, the trip was organised smoothly and our driver, Fredi, did a fantastic job, ensuring that we got from place to place safely and on time. We would certainly recommend going for a tour with JVTO!

We joined the 3D2N Mount Bromo, Madakaripura Waterfall, and Ijen Crater Tour and had an awesome time!

The tour was really well organized, with hikes spaced out just right so we had enough rest. There was also plenty of time to check out each spot. The food and accommodation were way better than we expected.

Big thanks to our guide Gufron—he's super friendly and fun to hang out with. His briefings (and pretty drawing) before each hike were professional, and he looked after us the whole trip. He also knows all the best spots for photos! Our driver Fredi was always on time. The whole crew made the trip amazing and totally unforgettable.

We highly recommend this tour!
10/10!!
Ahboy was a phenomenal Ijen guide from start to end. Not only was he incredibly knowledgeable and went out of his way to make sure everything we needed was sorted out (safety, logistics, equipment).
Visiting Mount Ijen was such a beautiful experience. We had a great time with our guide Ahboy he was so fun and helpful!

It was the best experience ever!! Our driver Pras and guide Rendi were the best, great people, super professionals and thoughtful, they took care of every detail and made us feel super safe and good.\nI recommended it 100%
I recently joined a tour to East Java with JVTO, and it was absolutely incredible! Our guide, Gufron, and driver, Holili, made the entire trip so comfortable and safe.
Being a solo traveler it was safe and stress free experience with JVTO. The staffs were on time and friendly. Loved the hotels and food recommendations got from the guides.

(Translated by Google) We did the 3D/2N Bromo-ijen-Madakaripura tour with them, and the experience couldn't have been better.

We looked at several options and decided on this one because the accommodations were better and included more meals, for a super reasonable price. As for the tour, they all offer practically the same things...

I'm giving them 5 stars because I can't give them more.

The organization of the entire tour is excellent, even though we booked with very little notice. Even before leaving Spain, the contact has been continuous, and from the minute we set foot in the airport, they have been attentive to us (and our belongings) at all times.

The tour is intense, but it's so worth it. I hope to keep it in my memory forever.
Transfers to the airport, train, etc. Meals, accommodation, guide, driver, tickets...
It's perfectly designed so that all you have to worry about is enjoying it.

Our guide, Ahboy, made a tremendous effort with us since we barely spoke English, but he made sure we understood each other perfectly. He was attentive, helpful, funny, a top-notch photographer, and a true professional.

And our driver, Holili, made sure we were the first to arrive wherever we went, driving carefully and with a constant smile on his face.

Thank you so much to the whole team!

The experience was truly a 10!

(Original)
Hicimos con ellos el tour de 3D/2N de Bromo-ijen-Madakaripura, y la experiencia no ha podido ser mejor.

Miramos bastantes opciones, y nos decidimos por esta porque los alojamientos eran mejores e incluía más comidas, por un precio súper razonable, en cuanto al recorrido todas ofrecen prácticamente lo mismo…

Les pongo 5 estrellas por que no puedo darles más

La organización de todo el tour es buenísima, y eso que nosotros contratamos con muy poquito tiempo de antelación, pero desde antes de salir de Espańa el contacto ha sido continuo, y desde el minuto 1 que pusimos un pie en el aeropuerto han estado pendientes de nosotros (y nuestras pertenencias) en todo momento.

El Tour es  intenso, pero merece muchísimo la pena. Espero tenerlo en mi retina para siempre
Traslados al aeropuerto, tren, etc. Comidas, alojamiento, guía, chofer, entradas…
Está perfectamente pensado para que solo te tengas que preocupar de disfrutarlo.

Nuestro guía Ahboy ha hecho un tremendo sobre esfuerzo con nosotros puesto que apenas hablamos inglés, pero él ha conseguido que nos entendamos perfectamente, atento, servicial, gracioso, un fotógrafo de primera en definitiva, un grandísimo profesional.

Y nuestro chofer Holili se ha preocupado en todo momento en que fuésemos los primeros en llegar a cualquier parte, prudente al volante y con una sonrisa continua en su cara.

Muchísimas gracias a todo el equipo!

De verdad que la experiencia ha sido de 10!
We can only praise the JVTO team, and above all our guide Rendi and our driver Joyo, in the highest terms. We came across JVTO by chance, and looking back, we are incredibly grateful.
Our driver Yandi was really reliable and friendly. He briefed us on what to expect for the day and was really helpful throughout our trip.

(Translated by Google) It was a very intense three days, but it was worth it. Perfectly organized, so you could just enjoy the trip. Communication with them before arriving in Indonesia was perfect and very fluid.
Thanks to the whole team!

(Original)
Han sido 3 días intensos (mucho ) pero vale la pena. Organización perfecta para que solo tengas que disfrutar del viaje. La comunicación con ellos antes de llegar a Indonesia fue perfecta y muy fluida.
Gracias a todo el equipo!

We had the best experience with Gufron as our guide for Mount Bromo and Mount Ijen! He was absolutely exceptional – always smiling, funny, and full of positive energy, yet never intrusive and always respectful of our space. He made the whole trip smooth, enjoyable, and memorable. We couldn't have asked for a better guide and we highly recommend him to anyone visiting Bromo and Ijen!
Our driver Goyo and Guide Ehboy were fantastic! We had such an incredible experience on the tour around East Java.
Guide Ehboy and driver Goyo were great! Had an amazing tour and enjoyed each bit of it. Would definitely recommend for anyone considering a trip.
